submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create one opaque full-bleed native game-map detail square. Image1 gives EXACT framing, scale, geometry and object footprints forr09_c10/r01_c01. The top neighboring reference band(s) each use first115 pixels as strict native context. Keep those source grooves, bevels, contours, scale and shadow endpoints exact. The following115 pixels (indices115..229) are guide-only halo softly transitioned into regional context; complete them coherently, without reproducing a compositing band as artwork. At a shared corner, the top/north strict source takes precedence. Never turn guide tone differences, straight compositing bounds, or softened reference edges into walls, steps, extra paving blocks, foliage edges, new shadows, or broken grooves. Reconstruct only the soft interior into crisp real hand-painted detail at matching scale. Do not move, crop, rotate, enlarge or recompose anything. Image2 is the user-confirmed PRIMARY painting/material reference: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy, readable smooth bevels and restrained low-contrast painterly surfaces. Copy no UI, words, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Inventory is determined only by Image1: retain only its existing materials, objects, foliage and shadows. A stone-only target must remain stone only. No added plants, flowers, gray paving blocks, walls, objects, stains or cast shadows. Quiet clean stone: no grit, cracks, veins, spotted noise, exaggerated brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Keep existing leaves rounded and clean. No new buildings, circles, stairs, medallions, symbols, characters, frames, labels or watermark. Return only the single native1254-square detail image at highest available fidelity.
Actual crop inventory: retain the existing pale stone rail/pillar at the far left, the existing rounded green shrub at upper-left, the original ivory paving slab grooves, and ONLY the two already visible cropped red-and-gold post parts at the lower edge/right. The red post is blank with no glyph, label or decorative motif. Do not erase these existing objects or reinterpret the pale rail as forbidden new gray paving. No bridge or water is visible in this crop, so do not invent either. Keep each cropped object exactly clipped by its current image edge. Preserve existing foliage shadows only; no new cast shadows. The top115 pixels are the actual north neighbor reference, with a guide-only soft115-pixel transition underneath; rebuild that transition into coherent art without a horizontal bar, repeated plant edge or abrupt groove ending. Preserve original scale and the exact clean slab junctions.
